title: Push draft end-to-end review post-recent-edits
description:
Read draft-atwood-jmap-chat-push-00.md end-to-end to confirm internal consistency after the recent normative changes in the main draft. The push draft references the main draft's permission vocabulary in places (line 180 references 'mention_all'), and the main-draft changes may have created drift.

Specific things to check:
- The chatPush configuration object and its semantics
- hasMention / hasMentionAll fields and whether their derivations still describe accurate server behavior given recent changes
- Encryption-related references (encrypted bodyType handling)
- Cross-references to the main draft for capability URNs, field names, error codes

Also: this bead pre-checks for the work that fig9.4 (push draft updates for broadcast mentions) will do. If specific issues are surfaced here that fig9.4 would touch anyway, note them as 'covered by fig9.4' rather than filing duplicates.

File specific findings as separate beads. Close with summary.
acceptance_criteria:
- Push draft read end-to-end
- Internal consistency confirmed or specific drift findings filed
- Cross-references to the main draft resolve and are accurate
- Findings that overlap with fig9.4 are noted as such, not duplicated
